flags.why: The common standalone meaning 'to rape' is missing ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/hi%E1%BA%BFp)).
The example describes dó paper rather than using dó to refer to the tree.
flags.fix: Vỏ cây dó được dùng để làm giấy. = The bark of the dó tree is used to make paper.

flags.why: Tráng means spreading or pouring a thin layer, and does not require cooking in a pan ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%C3%A1ng)).
flags.fix: to spread or pour (batter, beaten egg) into a thin layer for cooking

flags.why: The example explains the old term instead of using it.
flags.fix: Người ta bơm khinh khí vào quả bóng. = They pumped hydrogen into the balloon.

flags.why: This use is mainly Southern and lacks a regional label ([regional dictionary](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html)).
The example defines hoàng hậu instead of using the word in a situation.
flags.fix: Hoàng hậu bước vào cung điện. = The queen entered the palace.

flags.why: The meaning 'to economise' belongs to the full idiom thắt lưng buộc bụng, not thắt lưng alone ([idiom dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/that-lung-buoc-bung-eCfFVPquzMeFo.html)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense and place it under thắt lưng buộc bụng.
